split_strategy: Manual. Hard cases are bidirectional sibling deferrals — N1 (custom internal CRM → find-software-developer), N2 (mobile app → find-software-developer), N9 (full marketing scope → find-marketing-agency) — and the indirect intent positive P7 ('redesign and rebuild' without naming an agency type). Those go in train. Validation tests generalization across remaining platforms and out-of-scope shapes.
passing_rule: should_trigger=true → trigger_rate > 0.5 over 3 runs. should_trigger=false → trigger_rate ≤ 0.5.
